snippet.title: Kingdomino Mobile Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The official Kingdomino board game is landing on mobile devices for the first time! Pre-Order the classic beloved tile-placement kingdom building strategy on your mobile or tablet device. It's the complete game you love with no ads!

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kingdomino-the-board-game/id6468810215
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.meeplecorp.kingdomino
Official Kingdomino Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jKSnQ6WuCF
Kingdomino Digital Newsletter: https://meeplecorp.com/kingdomino/
